channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Vietnam's Party chief To Lam to co-chair Cambodia-Laos-Vietnam leaders' meeting during Phnom Penh visit
item.description: General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) To Lam will pay a state and working visit to Cambodia next Friday and co-chair a high-level meeting of the leaders of the ruling parties of Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia, the Vietnamese Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on Saturday.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City’s Turtle Lake gets fresh look ahead of Tet
item.description: The iconic Ho Con Rua (Turtle Lake) roundabout in downtown Ho Chi Minh City has emerged with a refreshed look after more than 10 days of renovation, attracting crowds of residents and visitors ahead of the Year of the Horse.

item.title: Vietnam wins 1 gold, 2 bronzes at International Project Chemistry Olympiad in Russia
item.description: Vietnamese high school students won one gold and two bronze medals at the 2026 International Project Chemistry Olympiad (IPCO) held in Russia, continuing the country's strong performance at the prestigious international chemistry competition, according to the Vietnam Chemical Society.

item.title: Vietnam orders crackdown on school violence, harmful online content
item.description: The Vietnamese government has issued a new directive demanding urgent measures to prevent school violence, including removing toxic online content that negatively affects students, amid growing public concern over serious incidents involving school-aged children.

item.title: Vietnam’s Dinh Bac sets record with multiple individual awards at AFC U23 Asian Cup
item.description: Vietnamese striker Nguyen Dinh Bac has made history at the 2026 AFC U23 Asian Cup by winning six individual awards, the most ever recorded in a single continental tournament at the junior level.

item.title: 2 dead, 3 hospitalized after drinking herbal liquor in Vietnam
item.description: Police in Dong Thap Province, southern Vietnam are investigating the deaths of two men and the hospitalization of three others after they drank homemade liquor infused with a traditional herb at a private home, authorities confirmed on Sunday.

item.title: Vietnamese police bust drug ring disguised as e-cigarettes targeting students
item.description: Vietnamese police have dismantled a drug trafficking network that operated under the guise of selling e-cigarettes and cannabinoids (CBD) vaping products, directly targeting teenagers and students.

item.title: Vietnam premier urges swift action to bolster state sector’s role in economic growth
item.description: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh has called for action-oriented reforms to strengthen the state-owned economic sector, including clarifying its role, removing bottlenecks in tapping national resources, expanding public–private cooperation, and piloting executive hiring to unlock new growth drivers for Vietnam’s economy.

item.title: Vietnam SJC gold slides to $6,430, then rebounds as global prices swing
item.description: Vietnam’s SJC gold price fell to VND167 million (US$6,430) per tael on Monday morning before rebounding quickly, tracking volatile moves in global bullion prices.
